title: Where Light Dies
narration: A shadow fifty-five million light-years away. First black hole ever seen. Its vast shadow could fit our solar system. Here, light gives up.
visual_goal: Open on 2019 orange-ringed black hole, zoom to show dark void swallowing a solar system.

title: The Invisible Giant
narration: Einstein's nineteen fifteen math predicted it—a ghost for a century. In twenty nineteen, an Earth-sized telescope caught it. In two thousand twenty-two, we saw Sagittarius A*: four million suns in a space smaller than Mercury's orbit. It still puzzles us.
visual_goal: Show sepia Einstein photo, flash to pulsing 2022 Sgr A* image over Milky Way.

title: A Collision in Time
narration: In twenty fifteen, we heard black holes collide—thirty-six and twenty-nine suns. The chirp carried more energy than all stars. They shook spacetime, like ripples. That detection proved Einstein's waves—a new sense: gravity.
visual_goal: Animated gravitational waves distorting starfield, then two dark objects spiraling in 90s anime style.

title: The Eraser
narration: Black holes keep only mass, charge, spin. All else is erased forever. Hawking asked: can the universe forget so much? A book burned leaves ashes—but black holes might destroy it completely. We still don't know.
visual_goal: Paper sketch of a sphere wiping equations, then ghost-like Hawking with musical notes evaporating.

title: The Final Page
narration: We can't touch it, but we saw it. That image is a door, not a destination. It holds secrets. The answer isn't in the image—it's in the next question we haven't asked yet.
visual_goal: Return to M87* image, fade to blank starry sky suggesting a waiting horizon.
